text.content: REFACTOR STATUS: Refactored for the consulting-led pivot (Debate #4). The old fixed 4-phase 90-day timeline (Map/Build/Calibrate/Causality) and the "consulting-as-an-upsell-above-the-product-stack" offer structure are dead — both assumed the same 3 products get built in the same order for every client. Surviving principles (consulting = R&D, continuous-value-not-a-black-box, SOP-as-training-data) are re-pointed below. Pricing/offer structure now lives on the Pricing page.
